business_problem: University POLITEHNICA of Bucharest wanted a scalable way to produce job-ready ServiceNow talent by embedding platform skills, certifications, and hands-on automation work directly into academic programs instead of treating them as optional extracurricular training.
solution_summary: University POLITEHNICA of Bucharest built its ServiceNow Academy by embedding ServiceNow University content into two degree pathways instead of treating certification as extracurricular training. In the master's Digital Government track, ServiceNow Administration Fundamentals and IT Service Management fundamentals underpin coursework on digitalization projects across government, IT, and business. In the undergraduate Computer Networks track, IT Operations Management labs let students discover and manage routers, switches, and servers while identifying operational issues. The program also adds certification vouchers, optional summer courses that satisfy practice requirements, and AI-focused content such as Flow Designer and automation workflows, so students learn platform operations and workflow design in one curriculum. By running coursework, labs, and certification preparation as one model, the academy turns ServiceNow training into a repeatable talent pipeline for employers.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow University
solution_components.role: Provides the role-based curriculum, labs, and certification preparation that the university embeds into degree programs.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Serves as the practical foundation in the master's curriculum for teaching digitalization workflows across government, IT, and business.

solution_components.name: IT Operations Management
solution_components.role: Gives undergraduate students hands-on labs for discovering network devices, managing them, and identifying operational problems.

solution_components.name: Flow Designer
solution_components.role: Introduces students to workflow automation as part of the program's newer AI-focused coursework.

data_flow: ServiceNow University content feeds master's and undergraduate coursework, where students apply IT Service Management concepts and IT Operations Management labs in practical exercises. That hands-on work then flows into CSA certification, thesis projects, and hiring pipelines so academic credit, platform practice, and employer-ready credentials reinforce each other.
business_outcome: The academy created two integrated degree pathways, placed 40 students into industry roles, attracted more than eight hiring partners, and produced certified graduates working across Romania, Germany, and Austria with skills employers are actively seeking.
